page.layout: One printed page, title page. Blocks top to bottom: title lines in large capitals and italic; a dedication block in roman and italic; an author line in spaced capitals with a short centred line below; a woodcut device (anchor with serpent and figures) in the centre; imprint lines at the foot. No margins with text. No running head, page number or signature.
page.notes: The title is set in italic and roman type with mixed capitals; the Greek-style letters are normal Latin. The woodcut device (anchor entwined with a serpent, flanked by two figures, with the motto "I" and "C" at its top) stands between the author line and the imprint and carries no text beyond those two letters. The ornamental initial "I" of "ITALICÆ" is a decorated capital, transcribed as printed.
